products.description: Clean brass should be the goal of every reloader. Cleaning brass by tumbling is the economical, safe first step in assembling quality handloads. Besides ensuring long life for the most valuable component of your ammunition, cleaning your brass will help reduce wear and tear on your expensive reloading dies, not to mention the chamber of your firearm. Grit and grime from uncleaned brass can become imbedded in the inner surfaces of your sizing dies, scratching and marring every subsequent case. The same grime can be expected to accelerate wear in the chamber and feeding system of your rifle or handgun.
features: Removes Grit and Grime from Uncleaned Brass
Reduces wear and Tear on Dies

products.title: FRANKFORD BRASS POLISH 8 OZ
products.description: Quick-n-EZ Brass Polish is ammonia free while polishing and protecting your brass. It comes in a citrus fragrance.

products.title: FRANKFORD CASE PREP AND TRIM SYSTEM
products.description: Frankford Arsenal's Case Trim & Prep Center accurately trims brass in seconds. An innovative case holder with adjustable collet and bushing system indexes the case shoulder and can be set to precisely trim brass to the exact desired length. Once the case holder is adjusted simply insert brass into the case holder as a collet aligns the case squarely with the hi-speed cutter. As the case mouth contacts the cutter it is trimmed until the case shoulder stops on an internal bushing. A series of three collets and six bushings (all included) accommodate any shouldered case from.17 Remington to.460 Weatherby. In addition to the cutter the station operates up to three additional tools at the same time. Inside and outside chamfer tools and primer pocket cleaners are included to fully prepare cases for loading. The heavy duty motor and drivetrain are optimized for durability and performance. Cutters and Chamfer tools are constructed of high quality hardened steel. A convenient built in storage box holds spare collets, bushings and tools.
features: Cutters Stay Sharp for Thousands of Rounds

products.title: FRANKFORD PLATINUM BRASS DRYER
products.description: The Frankford Arsenal Platinum Series Brass Dryer is a quick, convenient and efficient system for drying your brass. This dryer is the perfect tool for drying your rifle and pistol brass after wet case cleaning processes such as rotary tumbling or ultrasonic cleaning. The separate and removable trays let you dry different calibers at the same time without mixing them together. The Brass Dryer is a high-capacity unit that can dry up to 1000 pieces of .223 rifle brass or up to 2000 pieces of 9mm pistol brass. This dryer can dry your brass cases inside and out in under an hour. The forced air convection heating lessens the chance of watermarks on your newly clean brass. The powerful 500 watt heating system heats air quickly and consistently, which reduces drying time. The forced air flow design ensures that heat and air are evenly distributed throughout the separate trays, drying the cases inside and out. The top mounted fan ensures that no moisture from the cleaning process can accumulate in the circuitry. The drying trays have fine grated bottoms and retaining ribs to keep your brass separated on different layers. Combined with a Platinum Series Rotary Tumbler, dirty brass will be as shiny as new.

products.title: FRANKFORD HANDHELD DEPRIMING TOOL
products.description: The Frankford Arsenal Platinum Series Hand Deprimer is made of robust die cast aluminum and features a (patent pending) Universal Collet System. This deprimer can even deprime pistol brass, and military crimped primers are easily removed.

products.title: FRANKFORD ROTARY TUMBLER

products.title: FED SYN DEF 40S&W 175GR SJHP 20/200
products.description: Federal's all-new Syntech Defense provides dynamic terminal performance with a hollow-point bullet that separates into three segments and a deep-penetrating core on impact. The core penetrates 12 to 18 inches through bare ballistics gel -a critical benchmark in self-defense situations and the best terminal performance of any round in its class. The petals create three secondary channels, each more than 6 inches deep, adding to the terminal effect. Like all Syntech loads, Federal's advanced polymer jacket eliminates lead and copper fouling and drastically reduces damaging heat and friction in the barrel. Its Federal's exclusive Catalyst primer provides hot, extremely reliable ignition without the use of lead.

Equipped with a high-performance 1280x720 CMOS digital night vision sensor, these binoculars deliver exceptional clarity, allowing you to see the nocturnal world like never before. The 640x360 TFT LCD display enhances contrast, ensuring crystal-clear imagery that brings every detail to life. Capture your adventures with the built-in video recorder, capable of recording HD 1280x720 resolution footage for up to 11 hours. With nighttime recording capabilities extending beyond 150 yards, you won't miss a moment even in the darkest environments. Unleash your inner photographer with the HD 1280x720 photo resolution, saving your stunning images in JPEG format. The Hexcore's 1-3x digital zoom brings distant objects closer, enabling detailed exploration, while its integrated IR illuminator with 2200mW of power on high mode ensures clear visibility even in complete darkness. Powered by four included AA batteries, the Hexcore HD offers up to 8 hours of continuous daytime use. Whether you're venturing out during the day or night, these binoculars adapt to any lighting conditions and settings. The included DNV head mount allows you to convert them into night vision goggles, providing a hands-free experience.
features: DNV Head Mount, Neck strap and Carrying case
Records HD video and pictures to capture your moments in high definition
Full-color daytime video extends the use from day into night
Nighttime recording capabilities are effective out past 150 yards
1x base magnification enables head mount usage
3x digital zoom enhances extended range applications
Adapts to standard action camera mounting accessories
Use of micro memory cards gives you confidence that you will never run out of space

products.title: FIREFIELD AGILITY 1X30 DOT SIGHT
products.description: Designed for customization to the shooter's preference and quick target acquisition, the Firefield Agility 1x30 Dot Sight with Multi-Reticle features four different reticles available in red and green: 5 MOA Dot, Circle Dot, Crosshair and Circle Dot Crosshair. Featuring a weaver mount, the compact, lightweight sight is ideal for bolt action rifles, AR-15s, shotguns or even handguns for the daring marksman. Offering a wide field of view, the Agility 1x30 Dot Sight with Multi-Reticle features unlimited eye relief for comfortable viewing and is parallax corrected, ensuring the reticle remains in the same spot regardless of target range and aiming position. Engineered with an ergonomic, aluminum housing for exceptional durability and a weatherproof rating of IPX6, the device is nitrogen-filled, fog proof and shock proof, allowing for reliable use in a wide range of environments.

products.title: FIREFIELD IMPACT REFLEX SIGHT
products.description: Allowing shooters to engage their targets with both-eyes-open at close range, the Firefield Impact Reflex Sight is ideal for use on MSR platforms and shotguns. While many shooters customize their guns, Firefield Impact Reflex Sights are also customizable with multiple reticles and allow easy brightness level changes with digital switch brightness controls. Helping shooters stay aware of their surroundings, a wide angle lens permits a wide field of view and makes the reticle easier for the eye to pick up. 20-200 hours of battery life is achieved from a common CR2032 and is easily changed through the Impact's quick access battery compartment. The Impact's durable design makes it shockproof and an aluminum/polymer construction helps give the sight its IP55 water resistant rating.

products.title: FIREFIELD IMPACT XL REFLEX SIGHT
products.description: Helping bring targets down to size, the Firefield Impact XL is a compact reflex sight designed for use on modern sporting rifles and shotguns. Offering rapid target acquisition and unlimited eye relief for quick and easy aiming, the Impact XL features 4 different reticle options with 5 brightness settings providing ultimate user preference. Shockproof and IP55 water resistant, this robust reflex sight is housed in durable cast aluminum. Able to withstand recoil on firearms up to .308 caliber, the lightweight Impact XL weighs just 5.6 oz. and runs off a CR1632 battery. Included with the Impact XL are: neoprene cover, adjustment tools and batteries.

products.title: FIREFIELD IMPACT XLT REFLEX SIGHT
products.description: The Firefield Impact XLT is a full-sized reflex sight, ideal for target shooting and hunting on both shotguns and AR platform rifles. The versatile Impact XLT features a quick detach mount, allowing the sight to be taken on and off firearms quickly while still returning to zero. Impact XLT's are customizable by users, with 4 different reticle patterns and 5 brightness settings. An outer protective shield safeguards the shockproof optic and its components from impacts and hard use, while ergonomic digital switch controls make changing the brightness levels as quick as the Impact's rapid target acquisition. The lightweight Impact XLT runs on a long lasting, easy-to-find CR2032 battery and comes with neoprene cover, adjustment tools and batteries.

products.title: FIREFIELD IMPULSE COMPACT RED DOT
products.description: Helping shooters achieve lightning fast target acquisition, the Impulse 1x22 Dot Sight is ideal for target shooting and hunting on rifles and shotguns. Red or green reticle illumination lets shooters choose their preferred circle dot reticle color for different situations. Featuring an aluminum construction and matte black finish, the Impulse 1x22 offers shockproof, fog proof and IPX5 weatherproof protection. Weighing in at just 7.5 oz., this Texas designed optic is perfect for your next SBR or lightweight MSR build. 15-240 hours of battery life (depending on setting) is achieved from one CR2032 battery. The Impulse can handle recoil up to .50 caliber and comes with flip up lens caps and battery.

products.title: FIREFIELD 6-9" COMPACT BIPOD
products.description: Ideal for tactical training, competition shooting and hunting, this reliable device is the perfect accessory for any shooter. The Firefield Compact Bipod features a padded stock mount and adjustable legs that extend to multiple lengths ranging from 6-9 inches in length, ensuring a customized experience. Its compatible body style fits all rifle and shotgun barrels. The unit's rubber feet create maximum stability and its lightweight body is perfect for storage and carry. Featuring a durable aluminum construction, the Compact Bipod is easy to install, attaching to the firearm's swivel stud. The device is equipped with a pivot mount with tension adjustment and requires no firearm modification for use.

products.title: FIREFIELD 223/556  BORESIGHT
products.description: Reduce wasted ammo and keep precision accuracy at your fingertips with the Firefield .223 Remington Laser Bore Sight. products.title: FN FIVE SEVEN MRD 5.7X28MM 20RD BLK
products.description: With more than two decades of trusted service, the original FN Five-seveN breaks new ground in 2022, redefining handgun accuracy standards with new optics-ready capabilities, enhanced ergonomics, and improved controls. The FN Five-seveN MRD's proprietary optics-mounting system consists of a series of plates that match your optic to the slide for a quick and seamless setup - simply remove the cover plate, select the compatible optic plate and screw set that match your MRD and mount using the provided hardware. The system is compatible with most common optic footprints, offering an unmatched variety of options. New stippling and textures on the ergonomic frame as well as enhanced serrations on the slide, trigger guard and safety selector enable superior grip and control in an already soft-recoiling pistol. The internal hammer and smooth trigger pull, coupled with the long-lasting 4.8-inch cold hammer-forged barrel, provide the ultimate package to achieve precision at distance.

The 360 degree handle, tripod mount, and magnetic base allow you to put hands-free light anywhere you need it. And its IP66 rating helps make it durable enough for work, play, and everything in between.

products.title: FENIX CL28R 2000 LUMEN LANTERN GRY
products.description: The Fenix CL28R Lantern is a great option to light up your camp or work site. A 2000 max lumen white light output allows you to illuminate up a 160 degree area 190ft away. The most unique feature of the rechargeable lantern is the color dial which enables you to change the color temperature of the light from cool to warm-perfect for night photography and better color rendering. A separate red LED can be independently accessed for tasks where you need to preserve your night vision. The built-in batteries are charged via the USB-C port and the rechargeable lantern can even be used as a power bank to charge other devices. These features along with its magnetic base and tripod mount make this lantern the perfect hands-free lighting tool.

products.title: FENIX E01 V2 100 LUMEN KEYCHAIN BLK
products.description: The Fenix E01 V2.0 AAA Flashlight emits an impressive maximum 100 lumens from an included single AAA battery. Using an ultra-thin optical lens, this flashlight delivers a soft and balanced beam a max distance of 115ft (35m). Access three brightness levels with a quick twist of the head. At only 2.6" long and just over a half of an inch round, this little flashlight is built tough with an IP68 dustproof and waterproof rating. Super small and compact, this standard AAA battery flashlight is a great choice for your everyday carry needs.

products.title: FENIX E03R V2 500LUM KEYCHAIN GRAY
products.description: Super small and compact, the Fenix E03R V2.0 rechargeable keychain flashlight features upgraded performance with an extremely bright maximum 500 lumens. A single switch operates on/off and seven lighting modes, including four brightness levels, red light, red flashing, and a pulse light. The large battery level indicator lets you know when it's time to recharge the built-in battery via the USB Type-C charging port. This flashlight is built tough because of its all-metal construction and IP66 rating, making it heavy splashproof, and dustproof. Smaller than your key fob, the Fenix E03R V2.0 flashlight will be a welcomed addition to your keychain.
features: Two White Light LEDs and One Red Light LED

products.title: FENIX E05R 400LUMEN RCHRGBLE MINI BK
products.description: The Fenix E05R Keychain Flashlight is a great flashlight to carry every day. Less than 3" long and less than 1" round, this flashlight only weighs 0.85 ounces (24g) making it a light weight option for your keys, pocket or purse. Four brightness levels are accessed by pressing the side switch, and when you need extra power, hold the switch down for Instant Burst for a very bright 400 lumens. The built-in battery can be quickly charged by unscrewing the head to reveal the micro-USB charging port. Built for any situation, the Fenix E05R Keychain Flashlight is built tough, making it impact resistant, dustproof and waterproof. Trust this mini flashlight for your every day needs.

products.title: FENIX E06R 700 LUMEN LASER/UV GRAY
products.description: Don't underestimate the compact Fenix E06R it packs an impressive 700 lumens and a beam throw of 361 feet (110 meters). With 10 lighting modes including four brightness levels, a UV light, a red laser pointer, and four decorative ring light modes this small EDC flashlight is as practical as it is powerful. Equipped with a built-in 750mAh battery, it features a magnetic tail for hands-free use, decorative ring light, key ring loop, and a lock/unlock function to prevent accidental activation. Durable and feature-packed, the E06R is perfectly sized for everyday carry or as a dependable addition to your gear.
features: White Light, UV Light and Red Laser

products.title: FENIX E06RPRO 1600LUMEN RECHARGE BLK
products.description: The Fenix E06R PRO RG Flat Flashlight takes the best-selling design of the original E06R PRO and optimizes it for maximum visibility. In addition to an impressive 12 white-light modes, this specialized EDC flashlight comes equipped with a night-vision-preserving red light and high-visibility daylight-friendly green laser. Whether you are navigating in the dark or pointing out targets at a distance, the E06R PRO RG offers more practical utility for the modern EDC enthusiast. Packed with a total of 20 lighting modes, this light features an industry-rare dual-switch system. Both the side and tail switches operate independently, allowing you to use the light in a traditional handheld position or a tactical grip. Its standout feature is the independent spotlight and floodlight, which can be used separately or combined for an Instant Turbo of 1600 lumens. Built for daily carry, the E06R PRO RG is IP66-rated for heavy rain resistance and features a built-in 1650mAh battery with an inner-waterproof USB-C charging port. With its slim profile and unique dual light sources, it is the ultimate multifunctional tool for those who want professional performance in a pocket-friendly frame.
features: White Light, Red Light and Green Laser
3D Light Ring Provides Five Lighting Effects (Red Flash, Blue Flash, Red & Blue Flash, RGB, and Aurora)

products.title: FENIX E18R V2 RCHRGBLE 1200LUM BLK
products.description: The Fenix E18R V2.0 is an ultra-compact EDC (every day carry) flashlight with outstanding performance for a flashlight this small. Powered by one included 16340 li-ion battery, the E18R V2.0 emits a maximum of 1200 lumens a distance of 479ft (146m). The single side switch (no tail switch) controls six lighting modes including a moonlight mode for up-close tasks. Recharge the E18R V2.0 flashlight via its USB-C port when the battery level indicator indicates the battery is low. The E18R V2.0 is built tough with durable high-strength, oxidation-resistant aluminum and is waterproof underwater to 6.6ft (2m). Magnetic tail and a two-way body clip round out the features of this awesome little EDC flashlight.

products.title: FENIX E28R V2 RCHRGBLE 1700LUM BLK
products.description: The Fenix E28R V2.0 Rechargeable EDC Flashlight is a great flashlight packed full of features for everyday use. This flashlight can shine a maximum of 1700 lumens at a distance of 896ft (273m). Powered by an included 18650 (3400mAh) Li-ion battery, this flashlight is fully rechargeable via its USB Type-C charging port. A convenient side switch activates all lighting modes and includes a battery level indicator-helping you always know the status of your battery. Activate the pulse light for a great indicator light to know where you left your light. A two-way body clip and a magnetic base offer different hands-free lighting methods. Waterproof and dustproof, the Fenix E28R V2.0 Rechargeable Flashlight is a great everyday carry tool.

products.title: FENIX E35R 3100LUMEN RECHARGABLE BLK
products.description: Built-in rechargeability and improved performance are what make the Fenix E35R flashlight unique from its predecessor, the Fenix E35 V3.0. This small flashlight, which is only 4.72 inches long, is able to blast a maximum 3100 lumens 853 feet (260m) amazing for a flashlight this size! The single side switch activates on/off and all lighting modes no need for a tail switch. A magnet now sits where a tail switch normally would, allowing you to attach the flashlight to most metal surfaces for hands-free use. It's USB-C rechargeable with a battery level indicator and is waterproof and dustproof. When you need a rechargeable super bright EDC flashlight, the Fenix E35R is the perfect choice.

products.title: FENIX GL07 700 LUMEN PISTOL LIGHT
products.description: Illuminate your target with the Fenix GL07, the ultimate compact weapon light designed for concealed carry. Delivering a powerful 700 lumens, this tactical pistol light ensures clarity in any situation. The Fenix GL07 features a versatile quick-release rail mount, fits Glock and Picatinny rails, ensuring a perfect, secure fit on your compact pistol. Its modular design allows you to slide the light for optimal positioning, making it easily transferable between different firearms.

products.title: FENIX GL19R V2 1200LUM RECHARGE PSTL
products.description: The Fenix GL19R V2.0 tactical weapon light redefines pistol illumination, quadrupling the beam intensity and more than doubling the effective range of its predecessor. It delivers 1200 lumens an impressive 1378 feet (420 meters), ensuring superior target identification and unmatched situational awareness. Ambidextrous switches along with modular switch configuration offer effortless activation, while the quick-lock mechanism allows for rapid attachment and detachment to Glock or Picatinny rails for most full-sized pistols. USB Type-C rechargeable, impact resistant with an IP66 rating makes the GL19R V2.0 tactical weapon light a rugged and indispensable asset.

products.title: FENIX GL22 750LUMEN PISTOL W/RED LSR
products.description: The Fenix GL22 Tactical Weapon Light stands ready to become an important tool in your arsenal. Blasting 750 lumens, this pistol light can instantly throw that light 591ft with a simple tap of either the left or right switch-perfect for left- or right-handed shooters. You can also choose between the white light only, a red sighting laser for quicker acquisition of the target only, or have both on simultaneously. Plus you can disorient an assailant by holding the switch down to activate instant strobe. This weapon light easily attaches to full size (and some compact) pistols with a Glock or Picatinny rail. Impact resistant and IP66 rated dust and rain proof, the Fenix GL22 Weapon Light is ready for any tactical situation.
features: Will Fit Most Full Size Pistols with a Glock or MIL-STD-1913

products.title: FENIX GL23R 1200LUMEN RECHARGE W/GRN
products.description: The Fenix GL23R Weapon Light is a great accessory for your full-sized pistol. This light features three lighting modes including a 1200 lumen white light, a green laser, and the ability to use both at the same time. Why a green laser? A green laser is much more visible in the daylight vs. a red laser, giving you the added security of acquiring a target quickly in all conditions. Ambidextrous switches allow you to activate the light with either hand and the mode dial allows you to select the lighting mode easily. A rugged build along with a built-in USB Type-C charging port rounds out the features of this must-own weapon light.
features: Will Fit Most Full Size Pistols with a Glock or MIL-STD-1913

products.title: FENIX 800 LUMEN RECHARGE RIFLE LIGHT
products.description: The Fenix GL30R Weapon-Mounted Flashlight is the definitive all-in-one illumination solution for long-gun platforms. This comprehensive kit eliminates the guesswork of outfitting your firearm by providing a professional, mission-ready setup, including both Picatinny and Multi Rail Mount System mounting hardware. Despite its streamlined profile, the GL30R is a specialized long-range powerhouse, producing an incredibly intense 100,000 candela beam that reaches out to 2067ft (630m). Whether for tactical operations or specialized predator hunting, this light provides the extreme throw required to identify targets at distances reaching nearly 700 yards. Precision control is handled by the included AER-07 Tactical Remote Pressure Switch, which connects via a secure USB Type-C port featuring an anti-loosening lock to ensure a stable connection. The switch utilizes a patented dual-button interface for intuitive control of both momentary and constant-on activation. For added security, a mechanical locking slider prevents accidental activation during transport. The flashlight itself is constructed from A6061-T6 aluminum with a non-reflective, flat black matte finish, ensuring it stands up to the rigors of field use. Engineered for high-recoil environments, it features dual inner spring battery contacts to maintain stable lighting under fire. With integrated USB-C charging and an included ARB-L18-3400 V3.0 battery, the GL30R is a rugged, complete tactical system that is ready for deployment straight out of the box.

products.title: FENIX HL16 450LUMEN AAA HEADLAMP BLK
products.description: The new compact Fenix HL16 AAA Headlamp is battery-powered and can serve as your lighting companion in a multitude of tasks. This LED headlamp reaches a maximum of 450 lumens and can throw a beam as far as 341 feet (104 meters). The convenient dual switch quickly controls four brightness levels of white light mode, as well as red light and SOS Flash. Made from high-strength PC material, this lightweight headlamp is rugged and reliable. And the widened perforated headband makes this headlamp extremely comfortable and stable to wear. Coupled with IP66 water and dustproof protection, the HL16 can meet various outdoor and indoor lighting needs.

products.title: FENIX HL18RT 800 LUMEN HEADLAMP
products.description: The Fenix HL18R-T V2.0 Rechargeable Headlamp is built for those who refuse to slow down. With a powerful 800 maximum lumens and a 410 feet (125 meters) beam distance, it's perfect for early morning jogs, overnight excursions, or even your next DIY project. Choose between white, warm white, and red light modes with the easy-to-use top dual buttons, allowing quick and precise mode changes. At only 3.63 oz. (103g), this an extremely lightweight headlamp-perfect for running. The HL18R-T V2.0 is also equipped with a lockout slide switch to prevent accidental activation and a two-way SPORT fit headband system with an easy-to-adjust rotary dial for a secure, comfortable fit. Recharge with USB-C or swap in 3x AAA batteries when needed. Whatever challenge lies ahead, the Fenix HL18R-T V2.0 Headlamp is built to keep you going strong.
features: Compatible with Included 1900mAh Rechargeable li-on Battery Pack or (3) AAA Batteries

products.title: FENIX HL45R 1000 LUMEN HEADLAMP BLK
products.description: Engineered for outdoor pros and adventure seekers, the Fenix HL45R Rechargeable Headlamp is designed to tackle any challenge. Delivering up to 1000 lumens with a 722ft (220m) beam distance, it's the perfect headlamp for everything! The Fenix HL45R switches seamlessly between red and white light sources with the rotary dial and you can adjust the brightness level by simply tapping the side button. Additionally, the focus ring on this headlamp allows you to transition the white light from a wide flood to a concentrated spotlight. Featuring a gesture-sensing control, you can turn the headlamp on or off with just a wave of your hand. The Fenix HL45R Rechargeable Headlamp runs on a 1900mAh rechargeable battery but also accepts AAA batteries for flexibility. With durable aluminum alloy construction, IP66 waterproofing, and impact resistance, this rechargeable headlamp is ready for any environment.
features: Compatible with Included 1900mAh Rechargeable li-on Battery Pack or (3) AAA Batteries

products.title: FENIX HM23 V2 300LUM AA HEADLAMP
products.description: The Fenix HM23 V2.0 is an ultralight, AA-powered headlamp designed for outdoor enthusiasts and everyday users alike. It offers 300 lumens of light with a range of up to 289 feet (88 meters), making it ideal for hiking, camping, or nighttime tasks. Powered by a single included AA battery, the HM23 V2.0 is highly efficient, and its versatile design allows you to quickly detach the head and use it as a handheld flashlight. Key features include an electronic lock to prevent accidental activation, a magnetic tail, and a clip for hands-free use. With robust construction and a 50,000-hour LED lifespan, this headlamp is built for reliability and long-lasting performance.
features: Compatible with 14500mAh Rechargeable Battery or Included (1) AA Battery

products.title: FENIX HM50R V2 700LUM RCHRG HEADLAMP
products.description: The long awaited upgrade to Fenix's best selling headlamp, the Fenix HM50R V2.0, has everything you have come to love plus added performance and new features. Super small and light weight, this headlamp can now blast a maximum 700 lumens 377ft. The included 16340 rechargeable li-ion battery is USB Type-C rechargeable, and the headlamp includes a battery level indicator so you will always know the battery's status. Use the red light mode for up close tasks or to preserve your night vision, and use the red flash as a signaling device. Dustproof, waterproof and impact resistant to 2 meters, the Fenix HM50R V2.0 Rechargeable Headlamp is tough enough to hang with the big boys, but won't weigh you down on those long backcountry trips.

products.title: FENIX HM55R 1200 LUMEN HEADLMP BLK
products.description: The Fenix HM55R RENEGADE Headlamp is the exclusive U.S. version of Fenix's best-overall triple-LED headlamp, built for serious adventurers who demand power without the bulk. Weighing a mere 3.7 ounces, this very light headlamp delivers a commanding 1200 lumens of maximum output, illuminating your way up to 574ft (175m). Engineered for extreme versatility, the HM55R Renegade utilizes a triple-output system: a focused Spotlight for distance, a wide-area Floodlight for tasks, and a Red Light to preserve night vision. Power is supplied by the included 18350 battery, offering an exceptional runtime up to 120 hours. It is ready for the elements with an IP68 waterproof rating, and recharging is fast and simple via the built-in, waterproof USB Type-C port.

products.title: FENIX HM61R V3 1800LUM HEADLMP BLK
products.description: The Fenix HM61R V3.0 is a versatile headlamp designed for work, camping, and everyday outdoor use. A solid upgrade over its predecessor, the V3.0 now features both spotlight and floodlight modes, delivering up to 1800 lumens with a maximum beam throw of 640ft (195m). The HM61R V3.0's 4000mAh replaceable rechargeable battery provides an excellent balance of brightness and extended runtime, while USB-C charging makes powering up simple and fast. With a brighter 70-lumen red light, this headlamp also offers excellent performance for working in low light and preserving night vision. The HM61R V3.0 can detach from its comfortable headband to become a right-angle flashlight, and its magnetic base allows hands-free use when attached to most metal surfaces. Built with IP68 waterproofing and 2-meter impact resistance, the HM61R V3.0 Rechargeable Headlamp is a dependable lighting solution wherever the job (or adventure) takes you.

products.title: FENIX HM70R 1600 LUMEN HEADLAMP BLK
products.description: The Fenix HM70R Rechargeable Headlamp features a high-capacity 21700 battery, that not only boosts this headlamp to a maximum 1600 lumens, but also allows for a 100 continuous hour runtime when using 30 lumens on Low. Press and hold the large, glove-friendly switch to change over to the Functional mode to access two levels of neutral white light, a red reading light, and a red flash. The hidden USBC port adds to its IP68 dustproof/waterproof rating and allows you to quickly charge your headlamp with a 2A charging current. Battery level indicator, intelligent memory, and lock out function, round out the features of the Fenix HM70R Rechargeable Headlamp.

products.title: FENIX HM71R 2700 LUMEN HEADLAMP BLK
products.description: The Fenix HM71R Rechargeable Headlamp features a powerful spotlight with a maximum of 2700 lumens and a maximum beam distance of 755ft (230m). Cycle through eight lighting modes with the large, glove-friendly switch. The neutral light from the floodlight ensures better color rendering, and the 5-lumen reading light is perfect for up-close tasks. This headlamp is USB-C rechargeable with a battery level indicator and can run up to 400 hours. You can easily remove the headlamp from its base and use it as a right-angle flashlight, and the magnetic base allows for more hands-free lighting options. Perfect for the job site, and versatile enough for the outdoors, the Fenix HM71R Headlamp is a great choice.

products.title: FENIX HP25R V2 1600LUM HEADLAMP BLK
products.description: The upgraded Fenix HP25R V2.0 rechargeable headlamp is the new standard in high-performance rechargeable headlamps. Separately controlled switches control 10 modes of light from a neutral-white floodlight, a maximum 1600 lumen spotlight, and red reading light. The battery level indicator will let you know when it's time to recharge the included 21700 li-ion battery via its USB type-C port. Separate lamp and battery compartment make for a more balanced fit. 60 degree tilt lets you direct the beam as needed and the quality build makes it dustproof and heavy rain resistant, as well as impact resistant to 2 meters. The Fenix HP25R V2.0 Rechargeable Headlamp is powerful and will easily meet any need on the job site, search-and-rescue, or even cave exploration.

products.title: FENIX HP35R 4000 LUMEN HEADLAMP
products.description: Made for the professional and built for the extremes, the Fenix HP35R Rechargeable Professional Headlamp is built to perform. The glove-friendly, rotary and button combo switch allows you to choose between different levels of spotlight, floodlight, or both-for a jaw-dropping 4000 max lumens with an almost 500-yard throw. The battery pack contains two built-in 5000mAh batteries and can be used as a power bank to charge other devices. Built into the battery case is a red safety light used for alerting others to your location. The SAR edition comes with a heat-resistant silicon strap, helmet mount, and helmet clips, whereas the standard version has a perforated black-out strap.

products.title: FENIX HT32 2500 LUMEN RED/GRN BLK
products.description: The Fenix HT32 Flashlight is the gear you need for your next hunt or outdoor adventure. Boasting up to 2500 lumens of bright white light, this flashlight also features red or green LEDs-perfect for preserving night vision or not spooking prey. Its dual-switch controls make it easy to switch between colors and adjust light levels. With an extremely long throw, IP68 waterproof rating, and a rechargeable 21700 li-ion battery included, this flashlight makes choosing the right light a key to success.

products.title: FENIX AER-02 V2 ALG-05 MNT KIT
products.description: The Fenix AER-02 V2.0 is an upgraded model of Fenix's popular remote pressure switch. The perfect accessory for your rail mounted flashlight, this remote switch allow you quickly turn on/off your flashlight or select momentary on with the noiseless (no click) pressure pad switch. Easily attach your remote switch either by cable ties or Velcro (both included), or with the included ALG-05 mount included in this bundle. Made of durable, non-reflective materials this remote switch is IP68 rated dustproof and waterproof underwater to 2m. The Fenix ALG-05 tactical remote pressure switch mount is specially designed for Fenix AER series tactical remote pressure switches (remote pressure switches must be purchased separately when not purchasing the bundle). With a simple push, quickly and easily attach the mount to any standard Picatinny rail. This creates a secure hold for the AER pressure switch. The body of the mount is made of aluminum alloy with hard-anodized finish, and it is non-reflective with a matte black finish, making it better for tactical concealment.
features: Compatible with: PD32 V2.0, PD35 V2.0, PD35 V3/0, TK11TAC

products.title: FENIX LD22 V2 800LUM DF PENLIGHT
products.description: The upgraded Fenix LD22 V2.0 is a multi-use flashlight with a slim body design, multiple power options and great performance-perfect for just about every lighting task. This AA battery powered flashlight now includes a rechargeable li-ion battery pack. You not only get a great USB Type-C rechargeable power source, but you also get increased performance with a maximum 800 lumens of light. As an alternative, you can use two AA alkaline (included) or NiMH AA batteries (not included) for a maximum 350 lumens. The LD22 V2.0's slim design, 0.7" round, and reversible clip make it a great every day carry choice. Made of durable A6061-T6 aluminum, the LD22 V2.0 is impact resistant and waterproof underwater to 2 meters. 7 lighting modes including a Strobe, and SOS round out this great daily-use flashlight.
features: Instant Activation with the Tactical Tail Switch

products.title: FENIX LD30R 1700LUMEN RECHARGBLE BLK
products.description: The Fenix LD30R Rechargeable Flashlight is a powerful everyday carry flashlight with a maximum output of 1700 lumens. Activate it with the tactical tail switch and cycle through seven lighting modes using the side switch. USB Type-C rechargeable with a battery level indicator helps keep your flashlight charged and at the ready. Plus, its two-position body clip makes it even more convenient to carry. With a durable IP68-rated waterproof and dustproof rating, you'll have a flashlight that won't let you down.

products.title: FENIX LD35R 1800 LUMEN WHT/RED/BLUE
products.description: Need a flashlight that can do it all? Then the Fenix LD35R is the light for you. At a glance, it may look like your standard flashlight, but with its three lighting sources, color modes, Strobe, glass-breaking tips, and magnetic tail, the LD35R is anything but typical. Starting with the flashlight's forward-facing beam, this light puts out a maximum of 1800 lumens up to 1106ft (337m) over five lighting modes. The LD35R has two more lights, though-one on each side of the flashlight's head. These diffused side lights emit a soft white, lantern-like illumination, plus offer several combinations of red, blue, and flashing modes. Beyond illumination, this flashlight is emergency-ready with glass-breaking tips, Strobe, and SOS. With its magnetic tail, it can also be attached to most metal surfaces and go hands-free. The Fenix LD35R is more than just a flashlight; it's a lighting multi-tool ready for anything.

products.title: FENIX LD36R 3600 LUMEN MULTI COLORED
products.description: The Fenix LD36R Multicolor Flashlight isn't your average light. It's built for power, but packed with color. With an impressive maximum output of 3600 lumens and a beam that throws light over 1263 feet (385 meters), it delivers serious performance when you need it. But what makes this flashlight really unique is the built-in multicolor mode. Flip the toggle switch to activate vibrant color options like Sunrise Red, Sunset Orange, and Luminous Green. With a double tap of the switch, you can even seamlessly glide through a continuous spectrum of color to find just the right shade. This multicolor flashlight also comes with a diffuser tip so you can spread color across a wider area, making it a standout for creative lighting or just setting the scene your way. When it's time to get back to work, switch instantly back to bright white light with no fuss. Powered by a high-capacity ARB-L21-6000 battery and rechargeable via USB-C, the LD36R combines rugged utility with a lot of personality.

products.title: FENIX LR35RPRO 10000LUMEN W/SPOT-FLD
products.description: The Fenix LR35R PRO is a high-performance flashlight engineered for users who demand extreme brightness in a compact form. Delivering an impressive 10,000 lumens with a beam distance of up to 1640ft (500m), this powerhouse combines both spotlight and floodlight capabilities with smooth, stepless control via a rotary dial. It also features red light and UV modes, offering added functionality for professionals, outdoor explorers, and gear enthusiasts alike. Powered by two high-capacity 6000mAh batteries, the LR35R PRO offers extended runtimes and doubles as a power bank to keep your other devices charged in the field. Its rugged design includes a strike bezel with glass-breaking tips and the ability to tail stand, making it a versatile tool for demanding environments. With 11 total lighting modes and USB-C recharging, the LR35R PRO is one of the most feature-rich and powerful lights in the Fenix lineup-ideal for those who need serious illumination in a smaller, durable package.

products.title: FENIX LR36R 10000LUMEN & WHITE LASER
products.description: The Fenix LR36R is a powerful flashlight that combines a 10,000-lumen floodlight and a white laser into one versatile tool. Its white laser beam reaches an impressive 4134 feet (1260 meters), while the floodlight ensures wide-area illumination. The OLED smart display keeps you informed with real-time updates on your settings, and the rotating dial offers precise, stepless brightness control. With five modes-Floodlight, Laser, Floodlight + Laser, Strobe, and SOS-you'll always have the right lighting at your fingertips. Powered by dual 21700 rechargeable Li-ion batteries, the Fenix LR36R delivers up to 102 hours of runtime. With the Fenix LR36R, you get the perfect combination of power, precision, and reliability in one flashlight.

products.title: FENIX LR60R 21000 LUMEN RECHARGEABLE
products.description: The Fenix LR60R Search Flashlight is an advanced flashlight that is built for performance. Use its rotary switch to choose between 10 lighting modes-the floodlight for a wide field of view, the spotlight for long distances, or both for an extremely bright 21000 lumens of light. An OLED display shows you which mode you are on along with the remaining runtime. Quickly charge this flashlight's replaceable battery pack in as little as an hour and a half via the USB Type-C port, or use the discharge function to charge your other devices. Included is a tripod socket and shoulder strap used for hands-free lighting. A powerful light built for the pros makes this flashlight the ultimate tool for exploring and search and rescue.

products.title: FENIX PD26R ACE 1300LUM MULTI-MODE
products.description: The PD26R ACE is the most compact ACE flashlight yet! At just 4.17 inches long and 3.61 ounces, it slips easily into a pocket or bag, but packs major punch. With an impressive 1300 lumens that can reach 1161 feet (354 meters), this light proves big performance can come in small packages. What sets the PD26R ACE apart is its ability to choose a preset option to operate the flashlight as you need. Unscrew the flashlight's neck to reveal the SET button, and then choose between three preset options; set 1 for Turbo-only and instant maximum power, set 3 for Low/High/Turbo, or set 5 for all available modes. You can even deactivate Strobe if desired-giving you the ultimate control over your EDC flashlight. Power comes from a high-capacity 18350 1600mAh rechargeable battery, delivering runtimes of up to 556 hours on Moonlight mode. A discreet USB-C port makes charging effortless, and a built-in battery indicator keeps you informed of battery performance at a glance. Wrapped in durable A6061-T6 aluminum with a premium HAIII hard-anodized finish, the PD26R ACE is IP68-rated waterproof and can withstand the abuse of the every day or more. Compact, customizable, and rugged enough for daily use, the PD26R ACE has everything it needs to become your next go-to EDC flashlight.

products.title: FENIX PD35 V3 1700LUM EDC FLASHLIGHT
products.description: Version 3 of the Fenix PD35 flashlight is destined to continue to be one of Fenix's most popular models. With vastly improved performance, the new PD35 V3.0 can blast an amazing 1700 lumens a total distance of 1171 ft (357 m). The PD35 V3.0 is powered by a single 18650 rechargeable battery (included), or can operate on two disposable CR123A's. This flashlight has a runtime of 230 hours when using the 5 lumen Eco mode. Boot-up battery level indicator lets you always know the battery's status. On/off and momentary on are activated with the tail switch and six lighting modes are selected with the side switch. Compact and built-tough with an IP68 dustproof and waterproof rating, this flashlight is perfect for just about any outdoor or work activity.
features: Instant Activation with the Tactical Tail Switch

products.title: FENIX PD36RACE 3000 LUMEN MULTI-MODE
products.description: The Fenix PD36R ACE Rechargeable Flashlight pushes lighting to the next level. Delivering an impressive 3000 lumens of brightness and throwing light 1362 feet (415 meters), the PD36R ACE is built for users who want more power, more range, and more control. The PD36R ACE is built on everything that makes the popular PD36R flashlights best-sellers, but with an added level of operational customization. What sets the ACE line apart is its exclusive SET button, hidden beneath the flashlight's neck. This function allows you to choose how your light operates. Select preset option 1 for Turbo-only output, option 2 for Eco, Medium, and Turbo, or option 3 for the full range of modes-you can even deactivate Strobe if desired. Built from durable A6061-T6 aluminum with a HAIII hard-anodized finish, the PD36R ACE is designed to withstand tough conditions. A hidden USB-C port adds to its IP68 waterproof rating and the battery indicator helps ensure the included 5000mAh battery is 100% ready when you need it. With this degree of power, combined with the ACE level of control, the PD36R ACE is bound to become your next favorite flashlight.
features: Instant Activation with the Tactical Tail Switch

products.title: FENIX PD36R PRO 2800LUM RECHARGABLE
products.description: Fenix's best selling PD36R has gone PRO. It's everything you like about the PD36R, but with just a little more power on the top end. Featuring a maximum 2800 lumen Turbo mode, this flashlight can throw that light 1247 feet (380m). The glove-friendly dual tail switches control on/off, momentary on, and six lighting modes. The 5000mAh battery provides plenty of power to keep this light running up to 42 hours, and it is USB Type-C rechargeable. Built tough, the PD36R PRO is impact resistant, dustproof and waterproof underwater to 2 meters. Maximum brightness and solid performance makes this flashlight the one to own for all your lighting needs. The PD36R PRO is compatible with the AER-05 Remote Switch.
features: Instant Activation with the Tactical Tail Switch

products.title: FENIX SW05R 150 LUMEN AND RED LIGHT
products.description: Tough, practical, and ready for anything-the Fenix SW05R-RED is your new go-to clip on flashlight. With up to 150 lumens of brightness and a beam that can reach 128 feet (39 meters), it's perfect for anything from outdoor adventures to daily use. This clip on flashlight's 200 degree adjustable head means you can angle it to shine wherever you need and you also have the choice of 5 different lighting modes: low, medium, or high white light, red light, or red flash. This flashlight is extremely small with a large clip that lets you attach it to your hat or shirt pocket. Go hands-free with the magnetic tail mounted securely to most metal surfaces. Rechargeable via USB-C, this clip on flashlight is perfect for camping, outdoor adventures, or everyday tasks. Compact and ready for action, the SW05R-RED is the ultimate sidekick!

products.title: FENIX T6 80 LUMEN TACTICAL PENLIGHT
products.description: The Fenix T6 Penlight is not only an exquisite writing instrument, but it's also designed to be used as an EDC flashlight. The built-in flashlight allows you to have up to 80 lumens of light when you need it. The silicon nitride bead on the tail can be used to break glass in an emergency. The Schmidt ink cartridge makes writing smooth and effortless. Made of A6061-T6 aluminum, this penlight is built tough, and can withstand hard impacts and is dustproof and heavy splash resistant. The Fenix T6 is sure to become your favorite pen and EDC flashlight.

products.title: FENIX TK11R 1600 LUMENS TACTICAL
products.description: The Fenix TK11R Rechargeable Tactical Flashlight delivers a powerful 1600-lumen beam that reaches 1378 feet (420m). Dual tail switches provide quick and easy access to three brightness levels and a Strobe mode. This flashlight is powered by an included single 18650 Li-ion battery, or two CR123A batteries can be used as a backup power source. Check on the battery's status with the battery level indicator and recharge the light via the USB Type-C port. Impact-resistant and IP68-rated dust/waterproof round out the features that make the TK11R an affordable tactical performer.
features: Inner Waterproof USB Type-C Charging Port

products.title: FENIX TK16 V2 3100 LUMEN TAC LIGHT
products.description: The Fenix TK16 V2.0 is a tactical flashlight featuring incredible performance by throwing a maximum 3100 lumens 1247 feet (380m). Quickly and easily operate the light, and choose between six lighting modes, by using the dual tactical tail switches. It's durable and rugged with an IP68 dustproof and waterproof rating, plus the stainless steel strike bezel includes tungsten steel breaking tips. Powered by an included rechargeable 5000mAh li-ion battery make the Fenix TK16 V2.0 flashlight your go-to tool for long-lasting tactical performance.

products.title: FENIX TK21R 3600LUM RECHARGE TAC BLK
products.description: The Fenix TK21R is a rechargeable tactical flashlight built for high-demand situations where speed, power, and control matter. With a max output of 3600 lumens and a 1574ft (480m) beam distance, it delivers strong performance for law enforcement, security professionals, and first responders. The larger of its dual tactical tail switches offers immediate access to the Instant Turbo mode, giving users maximum brightness without cycling through other levels. The soft-press, forward clicky switch ensures more control when using momentary on, even under pressure. Powered by a high-capacity 6000mAh battery, this flashlight is USB-C rechargeable via its hidden port-which enhances its IP68 dust and waterproof rating. With glass breaking tips on the strike bezel, rugged aluminum alloy construction, and a matte black, non-reflective finish, the TK21R is engineered for those that demand more from their flashlight.

products.title: FENIX TK28R 6500LUMEN TACT W/260 RED
products.description: The TK28R is the mega-bright beast you've been waiting for. A powerful spotlight and floodlight combine to unleash an incredible 6500 lumens in a flat-body design, casting a beam so bright it floods your field of view with a massive hotspot for exceptional long-range visibility. A simple toggle switch lets you switch from white light to an extremely bright red light, and bypass all brightness levels with Instant Turbo. Powered by two 4000mAh rechargeable batteries, the TK28R runs for up to 102 hours and recharges in under 1.5 hours via its USB-C fast charging port, which is protected by a sliding cover. The flat-body design offers a comfortable grip and impressive balance, giving you serious power in a more compact form. The Fenix TK28R pushes the limits of what a flashlight can be: intense, versatile, and brilliantly engineered for those who demand more out of their gear.

products.title: FENIX TK30R WHITE LASER FLASHLIGHT
products.description: The Fenix TK30R is the ultimate long-distance tactical flashlight, designed for those who need exceptional reach and precision. With advanced white laser technology, the Fenix TK30R delivers an impressive beam distance of up to 4921 feet (1500 meters)-nearly a mile-making it perfect for situations where long-range visibility is essential. Its controls include a tactical tail switch for instant on/off and a rotary mode switch for quick adjustments between lockout, low, and high brightness levels. Constructed from durable A6061-T6 aluminum with a hard-anodized finish, the Fenix TK30R is built to withstand extreme conditions. Whether on patrol, search operations, or long-range scouting, the Fenix TK30R white laser flashlight delivers unmatched long-distance illumination, reliability, and performance for tactical professionals.

products.title: FENIX TK35R WHITE/RED LED LIGHT BLK
products.description: The all-new red light version of the TK35R isn't just an upgrade-it's a powerhouse built to blow expectations out of the water. With a searing 5800 lumens and a beam that reaches over 2000 feet (610 meters), this beast lights up the night like nothing else in your gear bag. Its dual 4000mAh batteries fuel up to 105 hours of runtime and power 8 versatile lighting modes including multiple levels of Red light and Instant Turbo-no need to cycle through brightness levels for maximum brightness. The tail switches include a Flexisensa switch for quick mode changes, while the built-in USB-C port now comes with a more durable sliding cover. Built for users who demand more from their gear, the TK35R offers serious brightness, runtime, and control.

products.title: FENIX WF26R 3000 LUMEN CRADLE CHARGE
products.description: Fenix's upgrade to the RC20 Flashlight, the WF26R is the perfect flashlight for those that need at-the-ready performance. Featuring its own charging cradle to store the light on, this flashlight's battery is always at 100%-ready to blast a maximum 3000 lumens. Six lighting modes are operated by the dual tail switches. A battery level indicator lets you always know the battery's available charge. The charging dock's cable can be removed so you can charge the flashlight independent of the cradle if needed. IP68 rated waterproof and dustproof make this flashlight with charging dock a durable workhorse that is always ready for any task.

Manufactured in-house from gun-barrel-quality bar-stock, the Match Series starts with 416-R in 5R rifling. 5R is a hybrid rifling, with lands opposite grooves and reduced sharp angles that reduces jacket deformation increasing velocity and easy cleaning. After rigorous testing, the barrels are Nitride treated inside and out, locking in the bore, improving barrel life, and keeping the elements at bay. The extension is coated in a Nickel Teflon coating that maintains incredible dry lubricity, corrosion resistance, and with the coating, tightens up fit between the extension and receiver - again improving upon accuracy. Combined, the Match Series of barrels are ready for when duty calls or the buzzer beeps with unrivaled performance value.

Constructed of 6061 Aluminum with a black anodized finish, Faxon Pistol Compensators feature a uniquely angled front port single chamber design, enabling the compensator to improve consistency while reducing muzzle climb and recoil. The angled ports allow gas to deflect upwards as opposed to only deflecting sideways, reducing up and down muzzle movement and improving reliability.
